description: Corrected superposition of Abitram onto GcvH structures: TM-score and core RMSD
code:
import requests, json, time, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
meta=S.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q80ZQ9',timeout=90).json()[0]
qpdb=S.get(meta['pdbUrl'],timeout=90).text
rr=S.post('https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket',files={'q':('q.pdb',qpdb)},
          data=[('mode','3diaa'),('database[]','pdb100')],timeout=180)
tid=rr.json()['id']
for k in range(90):
    st=S.get(f'https://search.foldseek.com/api/ticket/{tid}',timeout=60).json()
    if st.get('status') in ('COMPLETE','ERROR'): break
    time.sleep(4)
als=S.get(f'https://search.foldseek.com/api/result/{tid}/0',timeout=180).json()['results'][0]['alignments']
if als and isinstance(als[0],list): als=[x for s_ in als for x in s_]

qCA={}
for l in qpdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith('ATOM') and l[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        qCA[int(l[22:26])]=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])

def superpose(P,Q):
    pm,qm=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0)
    V,_,W=np.linalg.svd((P-pm).T@(Q-qm))
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,d])@W
    return (P-pm)@R, Q-qm, R, pm, qm

def tmscore_fixed(P,Q,Lref):
    """TM-score over a FIXED alignment, with iterative superposition seed search."""
    d0=max(1.24*(Lref-15)**(1/3)-1.8, 0.5)
    n=len(P); best=0.0
    seeds=[]
    for L in [n, n//2, n//4, 8]:
        L=max(L,4)
        for s in range(0,n-L+1,max(1,L//2)): seeds.append(np.arange(s,s+L))
    for idx in seeds:
        cur=idx
        for it in range(25):
            pm,qm=P[cur].mean(0),Q[cur].mean(0)
            V,_,W=np.linalg.svd((P[cur]-pm).T@(Q[cur]-qm))
            dd=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@W)); R=V@np.diag([1,1,dd])@W
            dist=np.linalg.norm((P-pm)@R-(Q-qm),axis=1)
            best=max(best, np.sum(1/(1+(dist/d0)**2))/Lref)
            new=np.where(dist<max(d0+1.0,3.5))[0]
            if len(new)<4 or (len(new)==len(cur) and np.array_equal(new,cur)): break
            cur=new
    return best

rows=[]
for a in als[:8]:
    tca=np.array([float(x) for x in a['tCa'].split(',')]); n=len(tca)//3
    T=tca.reshape(n,3)
    qi=a['qStartPos']; ti=a['dbStartPos']-1
    P=[];Q=[]
    for cq,ct in zip(a['qAln'],a['dbAln']):
        if cq!='-' and ct!='-' and qi in qCA and ti<n:
            P.append(qCA[qi]); Q.append(T[ti])
        if cq!='-': qi+=1
        if ct!='-': ti+=1
    P=np.array(P); Q=np.array(Q)
    A,B,_,_,_=superpose(P,Q)
    rmsd_all=np.sqrt(((A-B)**2).sum(1).mean())
    tm=tmscore_fixed(P,Q,Lref=min(a['qLen'],a['dbLen']))
    # core RMSD: trimmed on best-superposing 80%
    d=np.linalg.norm(A-B,axis=1); keep=np.argsort(d)[:int(0.8*len(d))]
    A2,B2,_,_,_=superpose(P[keep],Q[keep]); rmsd_core=np.sqrt(((A2-B2)**2).sum(1).mean())
    rows.append(dict(pdb=a['target'].split('-assembly')[0].upper(), organism=a['taxName'],
                     evalue=a['eval'], pairs=len(P), rmsd_all=rmsd_all, rmsd_core80=rmsd_core,
                     TM=tm, seqid_pct=a['seqId']))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df['protein']='glycine cleavage system H protein (GcvH)'
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nmedian TM = %.3f ; median core RMSD = %.2f A"%(df.TM.median(), df.rmsd_core80.median()))
df.to_csv('/tmp/foldseek_tm.csv',index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11.5,4.3))
o=df.sort_values('TM')
ax[0].barh(o.pdb,o.TM,color='#4C78A8')
ax[0].axvline(0.5,ls='--',c='#E45756'); ax[0].text(0.505,0.3,'TM = 0.5\nsame fold',color='#E45756',fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlim(0,0.75); ax[0].set_xlabel('TM-score to mouse Abitram AlphaFold model')
ax[0].set_title('All significant PDB structural neighbours\nof Abitram are GcvH proteins', fontsize=10)
ax[1].scatter(df.seqid_pct,df.rmsd_core80,s=70,color='#F58518',zorder=3)
for _,r in df.iterrows(): ax[1].annotate(r.pdb,(r.seqid_pct,r.rmsd_core80),fontsize=8,xytext=(4,4),textcoords='offset points')
ax[1].set_xlabel('sequence identity over structural alignment (%)')
ax[1].set_ylabel('core CA RMSD, best 80% of pairs (A)')
ax[1].set_title('Twilight-zone identity, conserved beta-sandwich core',fontsize=10)
ax[1].grid(alpha=.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
